mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.name, tc.price, tc.limit_per_user, IFNULL(scs.stock, 0) - IFNULL(scs.sold_count, 0) AS remainStock, IFNULL(scs.member_stock, 0) - IFNULL(scs.sold_member_count, 0) AS memberRemainStock FROM ticket_category tc LEFT JOIN session_category_stock scs ON scs.category_id = tc.id AND scs.session_id = #{sessionId} WHERE tc.show_id = #{showId}
